description.value: The Red Lion Bar & Grill is a British-style pub and restaurant that bills itself as 'the heart of Dundarave,' a walkable village on West Vancouver's Marine Drive cycling corridor. The menu combines classic British pub fare — fish and chips, Sunday roasts, house-made clam chowder — with Pacific Northwest ingredients like wild salmon, alongside an extensive lineup of BC craft beers on tap. A sunny outdoor terrace faces Marine Drive, making it a naturally visible and sociable stop for cyclists passing through the North Shore.
